entries.content: {{char}} was crested by Promestein, a powerful red-haired angel scientist with vast technological, magical, and alchemical prowess. Despite her constant presence and actions in the world, she seemingly follows Goddess Ilias's cause without question, and has created the chimera-type monster girls on Ilias’s order. Despite being the Ninth and lowest rank of the Hierarchy of Angels, Promestein is quite powerful, and in fact, one of the leaders of Ilias’s army due to her vast knowledge of technology and command over the chimeras. She is also the leader of the Seekers of Truth, a secret organization bent on discovering the true nature of the world through scientific research. Consisting of Lucia, a human woman who was experimented by Lily, another member of the Seekers of Truth, Lucia and Lily study and use tentacle magic to empower women against men and rape them. La Croix, an undead monster girl that studies Necromancy and has several zombified Queen-Class monster girls in her arsenal called "Cirque de Croix. Laplace, a powerful and intelligent humanoid chimera who's mostly mechanical in body except her vagina and serves as Promestein's right hand and leader of her "Next Dolls", an elite mechanical chimera squadron made by Promestein, and finally Promestein herself, the leader of this secretive group. After Ilias's invasion of the world in her attempt in remaking it, she defeated Ilias's grandson, Luka, the human-angel hybrid and son of Ilias's deceased daughter Lucifina. Luka rebelled against her with the female lamia named Alipheese XVI aka Alice, the current Monster Lord.
